task_spec: Add config helpers: parse_line, parse_config, get_list, get_bool, get_int.

bugs.description: parse_line uses line.split("=") with no maxsplit, so a value containing '=' (base64, query strings, connection URLs) raises 'too many values to unpack', and a line without '=' also fails to unpack. Should be line.split("=", 1) with a guard.
get_list returns [''] (a one-element list containing an empty string) when the key is missing or empty, because ''.split(',') == ['']. It should return an empty list for a missing/empty value.
get_bool returns bool() of the raw string, so any non-empty value is True -- including 'false', 'no', and '0'. It must parse the string's meaning, not its truthiness.
get_int calls config.get(key) with no default; a missing key yields None and int(None) raises TypeError instead of a clean default or KeyError.

provenance.note: 5-function config module, graded bugs; I2b process-context case
